title: THE FLOOR CARD AND BACKPACK ARE SOLID
why: His note after playing: the UI is not as clean as it should be. In the pictures, the What is New card on the Undercroft floor was a flat plate at 94 percent with its own blue-grey border, unlike every other panel, and the Undercroft backpack was a plate at 96 percent; the big station signs (SHOP, CRAFT AND HIRE, THE STASH, SETTINGS) showed through the words of both. They are the one solid game plate now, with the amber tick. In a raid the backpack still lets the world show through.
now: The What is New card and the Undercroft backpack are solid plates.
